mapper.select: select from mall_item_after_sale where after_sale_id=#{afterSaleId} for update
select from mall_item_after_sale where after_sale_id=#{afterSaleId} and member_id=#{memberId}
select from mall_item_after_sale where after_sale_id=#{afterSaleId} and member_id=#{memberId} for update
select from mall_item_after_sale where member_id=#{memberId} order by create_time desc,after_sale_id desc

select after_sale_item_id,after_sale_id,order_item_id,sku_id,product_name,sku_name,order_quantity,requested_quantity,unit_price,refund_amount from mall_item_after_sale_item where after_sale_id=#{afterSaleId} order by after_sale_item_id

select coalesce(sum(i.requested_quantity),0) from mall_item_after_sale_item i join mall_item_after_sale a on a.after_sale_id=i.after_sale_id where i.order_item_id=#{orderItemId} and a.status in ('PENDING_REVIEW','APPROVED','RETURN_SHIPPED','REFUNDING','SUCCESS')
mapper.update: update mall_item_after_sale set status='APPROVED',update_time=now() where after_sale_id=#{afterSaleId} and status='PENDING_REVIEW'
update mall_item_after_sale set status='REJECTED',failure_reason=#{reason},update_time=now() where after_sale_id=#{afterSaleId} and status='PENDING_REVIEW'

update mall_item_after_sale set return_company_code=#{companyCode},return_tracking_no=#{trackingNo},status='RETURN_SHIPPED',update_time=now() where after_sale_id=#{afterSaleId} and status='APPROVED' and type='RETURN_REFUND'
update mall_item_after_sale set status='REFUNDING',update_time=now() where after_sale_id=#{afterSaleId} and status in ('APPROVED','RETURN_SHIPPED')
update mall_item_after_sale set status='SUCCESS',provider_refund_no=#{providerRefundNo},refund_time=now(),update_time=now() where after_sale_id=#{afterSaleId} and status='REFUNDING'
update mall_item_after_sale set status='FAILED',failure_reason=#{reason},update_time=now() where after_sale_id=#{afterSaleId} and status='REFUNDING'
mapper.select: select from mall_item_after_sale status=#{status} order by create_time desc,after_sale_id desc
